morphology.pattern_note: 地理专名，整词记忆，不拆出马来语词缀。保留输入检索键 filipina，标准正文写作 Filipina；未确认独立派生词，词族留空。

senses.zh_definition: 菲律宾，东南亚的群岛国家；正式国名为菲律宾共和国。
senses.en_definition: The Philippines, an archipelagic country in Southeast Asia.
senses.ms_definition: Nama sebuah negara kepulauan di Asia Tenggara, iaitu Republik Filipina.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，标准书写首字母大写。orang Filipina、warga Filipina 指菲律宾人，不限定性别；不能照搬英语 Filipina 专指女性的用法。马来文释义为编写释义，并非输入包未提供的 DBP 原文。[DBP 马来文用例](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2024/03/05/12417/)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Syarikat itu merancang untuk memperluas rangkaian pengedarannya ke Filipina pada tahun hadapan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该公司计划明年将分销网络扩展至菲律宾。
dual_scenarios.en: The company plans to expand its distribution network to the Philippines next year.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Awak nak pergi Filipina bulan depan, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Awak hendak pergi ke Filipina pada bulan hadapan, betul?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你下个月要去菲律宾，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: You're going to the Philippines next month, right?
spoken_features: nak 是 hendak 的口语形式。
kan 在句末用于寻求确认。
口语 pergi Filipina 可省略方向介词 ke。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Awak nak pergi Filipina bulan depan, kan? Tiket dah beli?
messages.ms_standard: Awak hendak pergi ke Filipina pada bulan hadapan, betul? Adakah tiket sudah dibeli?
messages.zh: 你下个月要去菲律宾，对吧？票买了吗？
messages.en: You're going to the Philippines next month, right? Have you bought your ticket?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Saya nak duduk kat Manila tiga hari je.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah. Saya hendak tinggal di Manila selama tiga hari sahaja.
messages.zh: 买了。我打算只在马尼拉待三天。
messages.en: Yes. I'm only staying in Manila for three days.

etymology.historical_story: The name belongs to the same historical naming tradition as Spanish Filipinas. During the Villalobos expedition in 1543, a name honouring Prince Felipe, the future Philip II of Spain, was applied to an island in the Visayas. It subsequently extended to the archipelago. This explains the royal name behind Malay Filipina, without establishing its immediate borrowing route. [Philippine National Commission for Culture and the Arts](https://ncca.gov.ph/about-culture-and-arts/in-focus/philippines-gateway-to-the-orient-from-legazpi-to-malaspina/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Filipina 与中文“菲律宾”的声音相近：听到 fi-li-pi-na，就把地图上的菲律宾群岛连起来。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称呼国籍时用 orang Filipina 或 warga Filipina，语气中性且不限定性别。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 不要根据国籍推断职业、宗教或母语。涉及个人身份时采用对方自述的称呼；标准书面语须保留 Filipina 的大写首字母。
